purpose: Full fixed balanced policy-visited labels; no gradient training.

model.selection: Fixed10102 used throughout phase diagnostics; not a new model selected from these games.

selection: Exactly the previously frozen whole-deal split and all selected roots. No filtering by outcomes, disagreement, uncertainty or teacher gain.
targets: Keep every paired sample and negative or uncertain advantage over parent. Equal continuation-mode mixture, first average matched worlds across modes, then concatenate independent A/B batches into192 world pairs.
beliefs: Use checked public policy-consistent committed sealed bids, with legal passes and the same policy as each continuation mode. No true hidden bids, future deck or real seed.
options: Same six-proposal geographic/economic shortlist plus exact frozen parent proposal. Compatible with existing4.3 scope; no unsupported out-of-shortlist targets.
admission: Each job <=96 new roots. 2x slowest measured pilot A+B position at the same count/mode, plus600s overhead, <=75% of8h. First wave is one shard per count/behavior/opponent/mode; require independent verification of all60 before remaining planned shards.
runtime: Frozen pilot evaluator, encoder, model, engine and checker; four concurrent inference batches retain exact64-row batches. Independent HF profile checked raw scores/values on2553 fixtures and full choice transcripts/outcomes on3072 continuations. Use conservative serial pilot runtime bounds.
